statements.description: If the client receives no response to DHCP messages sent to the IP address of a known DHCP server, the DHCP client reverts to using the IP broadcast address.
actions: revert to sending DHCP messages to IP broadcast address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client unicasts DHCPRELEASE messages to the server. Because the client is declining the use of the IP address supplied by the server, the client broadcasts DHCPDECLINE messages.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Because the client is declining the use of the IP address supplied by the server, the client broadcasts DHCPDECLINE messages.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When the DHCP client knows the address of a DHCP server, in either INIT or REBOOTING state, the client may use that address in the DHCPDISCOVER or DHCPREQUEST rather than the IP broadcast address.
actions: use known server unicast address as destination instead of IP broadcast address in DHCPDISCOVER or DHCPREQUEST

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client may also use unicast to send DHCPINFORM messages to a known DHCP server.
actions: send DHCPINFORM via unicast to known DHCP server address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: T1 is the time at which the client enters the RENEWING state and attempts to contact the server that originally issued the client's network address.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: T2 is the time at which the client enters the REBINDING state and attempts to contact any server.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client has successfully reacquired its network address, returns to BOUND state and may continue network processing.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the lease expires before the client receives a DHCPACK, the client moves to INIT state, MUST immediately stop any other network processing and requests network initialization parameters as if the client were uninitialized.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: At time T1 the client moves to RENEWING state and sends (via unicast) a DHCPREQUEST message to the server to extend its lease.
actions: set ciaddr to current network address
record local time of DHCPREQUEST transmission

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When the client receives a DHCPACK from the server, the client computes the lease expiration time as the sum of the time at which the client sent the DHCPREQUEST message and the duration of the lease in the DHCPACK message. The client has successfully reacquired its network address, returns to BOUND state and may continue network processing.
actions: compute lease expiration time as DHCPREQUEST_send_time + lease_duration

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If no DHCPACK arrives before time T2, the client moves to REBINDING state and sends (via broadcast) a DHCPREQUEST message to extend its lease.
statements.pre_cond: client.state = RENEWING & timer.T2 = expired & DHCPACK.received = false
actions: set ciaddr to current network address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: In both RENEWING and REBINDING states, if the client receives no response to its DHCPREQUEST message, the client SHOULD wait one-half of the remaining lease time (in REBINDING state), down to a minimum of 60 seconds, before retransmitting the DHCPREQUEST message.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A client MAY choose to renew or extend its lease prior to T1.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The client MUST NOT include a 'server identifier' in the DHCPREQUEST message (in RENEWING and REBINDING states).

statements.subject: client
statements.description: T1 MUST be earlier than T2, which, in turn, MUST be earlier than the time at which the client's lease will expire.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: Times T1 and T2 SHOULD be chosen with some random "fuzz" around a fixed value, to avoid synchronization of client reacquisition.
actions: apply random fuzz to T1 and T2 values around their fixed base values to prevent synchronized client reacquisition

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MAY choose to extend the client's lease according to policy set by the network administrator.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server SHOULD return T1 and T2, and their values SHOULD be adjusted from their original values to take account of the time remaining on the lease.
actions: include T1 option in DHCPACK adjusted for time remaining on lease
include T2 option in DHCPACK adjusted for time remaining on lease

statements.subject: client
statements.description: In both RENEWING and REBINDING states, if the client receives no response to its DHCPREQUEST message, the client SHOULD wait one-half of the remaining time until T2 (in RENEWING state) and one-half of the remaining lease time (in REBINDING state), down to a minimum of 60 seconds, before retransmitting the DHCPREQUEST message.
actions: if client.state = RENEWING: wait max(60s, 0.5 * (T2 - current_time)) before retransmitting DHCPREQUEST
if client.state = REBINDING: wait max(60s, 0.5 * remaining_lease_time) before retransmitting DHCPREQUEST

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the lease expires before the client receives a DHCPACK, the client moves to INIT state, MUST immediately stop any other network processing and requests network initialization parameters as if the client were uninitialized.
actions: immediately stop all other network processing
request network initialization parameters as if uninitialized

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the client then receives a DHCPACK allocating that client its previous network address, the client SHOULD continue network processing.
actions: resume network processing with previously held network address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the client is given a new network address, it MUST NOT continue using the previous network address and SHOULD notify the local users of the problem.
actions: cease using previous network address immediately

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the client no longer requires use of its assigned network address (e.g., the client is gracefully shut down), the client sends a DHCPRELEASE message to the server.
